title: VooPoo TPP Pod Tank
description: Built for Voopoo’s Drag X device, the TPP pod tank combines the simplicity of a modern pod with the performance of a sub-ohm vape tank. Featuring a convenient bottom-filling system and capable of holding up to 2ml of your favourite eliquid, it can be used with either high VG or high PG eliquid depending on which of Voopoo’s celebrated PnP/TPP coils you've chosen. The adjustable airflow on this tank can be used to increase or decrease vapour flow for a tighter or looser draw. The use of hard-wearing plastics over glass ensure this pod tank is sturdier and longer lasting than glass tanks. This tank is 510 threaded, meaning it's compatible with the majority of vape mods. The Voopoo Drag-X TPP Pod Tank features a brand-new range of coils to join Voopoo's arsenal, The TPP series. The new TPP coils are uniquely smooth and flavoursome coils made primarily for sub-ohm vapers but provide an amazing experience at higher wattages too. TPP-DM1 0.15ohm Coil - 60w - 80w TPP-DM2 0.2ohm Coil - 40w - 60w
